meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: Claude 会使用 HyperFrames 工具链创作或修改自定义视频合成:先更新技能,再依据项目状态(BRIEF.md 等)规划,分阶段执行计划、分镜、场景构建与渲染,并处理媒体素材和 Figma 输入。
howto.when: 当没有专用流程匹配、需要创作或编辑自定义 HyperFrames 视频合成时触发;也适用于 BRIEF.md 指定 flow: companion。典型用途有多场景影片、品牌片、蒙太奇等。

say.text: 帮我规划一部三场景的产品宣传片。
say.note: 会先写 BRIEF.md 并制定计划。

say.text: 把这段素材剪成品牌片,配上音乐和字幕。
say.note: 会调用媒体适配器处理素材。

say.text: 用 companion 模式和我一起设计这部短片的分镜。
say.note: 会先给出完整方案再逐项确认。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the HyperFrames toolchain to author/edit custom video compositions: updates the skill, checks project state (BRIEF.md), plans, and executes storyboard/scene building/rendering, while handling media and Figma inputs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits and a custom HyperFrames composition is needed, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Typical uses: multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, etc.

say_en.text: Help me plan a three-scene product promo.
say_en.note: It will write BRIEF.md and start planning.

say_en.text: Edit this footage into a brand reel with music and captions.
say_en.note: It will use media adapters and build scenes.

say_en.text: Let's design the storyboard together in companion mode.
say_en.note: It will first give a full treatment.
